text:
Easy pancakes

Makes 12 thin pancakes, serves 4. 25 minutes.

250 g plain flour
500 ml milk
2 eggs
20 g sugar
a pinch of salt
30 g butter, melted

1. Whisk the flour, sugar and salt with half of the milk until smooth.
2. Beat in the eggs, then the rest of the milk and the melted butter.
3. Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
4. Fry thin pancakes in a hot, lightly greased pan, about 1 minute per side.
